repositories.description: Automates your job search from scraping to tailored resumes. Pulls jobs from LinkedIn, Greenhouse and Lever every hour, scores them against your skills, and uses a local LLM to tailor a one-page PDF resume for each role. No API costs, no data leaving your machine. Use the hosted UI at application.atriveo.com or run everything locally.
